description: Multidimensional linguistic taxonomy for Indonesian synthetic casual-language data.

domain.name: Social Media
domain.description: Language used in social-media posts, comments, replies, captions, and interactions.

domain.name: Gaming
domain.description: Language used in online games, multiplayer communities, streaming, and gaming chats.

domain.name: Fintech
domain.description: Casual language related to digital payments, e-wallets, paylater, lending, and financial applications.

domain.name: Personal Finance
domain.description: Casual language related to saving, investing, budgeting, income, spending, and financial goals.

domain.name: Cryptocurrency
domain.description: Language used around cryptocurrency, trading, tokens, market movements, and crypto communities.

domain.name: Workplace
domain.description: Casual language used in professional, office, freelance, startup, and remote-work environments.

domain.name: Education
domain.description: Language used in school, university, courses, study groups, and educational communities.

domain.name: Technology
domain.description: Casual language related to software, hardware, AI, programming, and digital technology.

domain.name: E-commerce
domain.description: Language used around online shopping, marketplaces, promotions, checkout, delivery, and product discovery.

domain.name: Dating and Relationships
domain.description: Casual language involving dating, friendship, relationships, attraction, and interpersonal interaction.

domain.name: Entertainment
domain.description: Language related to music, movies, television, celebrities, fandoms, and popular culture.

domain.name: Lifestyle
domain.description: Language related to fashion, travel, wellness, hobbies, food, leisure, and everyday lifestyle.

domain.name: Food and Culinary
domain.description: Casual language related to food, restaurants, cooking, beverages, and culinary experiences.

domain.name: Meme and Internet Humor
domain.description: Language associated with memes, viral expressions, humorous formats, and internet culture.

domain.name: Community
domain.description: Language used within local, hobby, interest-based, or online communities.

generation.name: Gen Z
generation.description: Digital-native casual language associated with younger Indonesian internet users.

generation.name: Millennial
generation.description: Casual language associated with Indonesian millennial internet and workplace culture.

generation.name: Cross-generation
generation.description: Expressions commonly understandable across multiple generations.

register.name: Internet Casual
register.description: Language strongly associated with online communication.

register.name: Urban Casual
register.description: Informal language associated with urban Indonesian communication.

register.name: Humorous
register.description: Language primarily used for jokes, irony, memes, or playful interaction.

register.name: Sarcastic
register.description: Language using irony, mockery, or indirect criticism.

register.name: Highly Emotive
register.description: Language with strong emotional or expressive characteristics.

code_switching.name: Indonesian Only
code_switching.description: Primarily Indonesian without meaningful language switching.

code_switching.name: Indonesian-English
code_switching.description: Indonesian combined with English words or phrases.

code_switching.name: Indonesian-Manado Malay
code_switching.description: Indonesian combined with Manado Malay expressions.

code_switching.name: Multilingual
